model: OpenAI built-in image model (model identifier not exposed)
style: Soft glowing watercolour-and-gouache storybook gems on cream paper; glossy, sparkling, iridescent and translucent jewel-box richness; strong highlights and luminous crystal surfaces; no text.

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Square cover in the reference gem look: preserve the cast-sheet identities, exact outfits, age difference and Vanilla markings. At a sunlit wooden table by a window, the children and Vanilla discover an open jewel box and tray of sparkling gems, with a magnifying glass and calm upper-third title space. Gentle cast-sheet storybook characters lit by gem glow; safe behaviour; no text.

images.name: what-is-a-gem
images.prompt: Object-only hero still life: one large rich pink-violet faceted gem on a cream velvet cushion, spaciously surrounded by five cut gems of different colours and shapes, with strong glints and a deep plum-and-teal jewel-box background. No people or text.

images.name: minerals
images.prompt: Object-only natural scene: raw green, violet and clear mineral specimens resting untouched on mossy rock in soft daylight, visibly made by nature. Uncut, organic sparkle; no tools, jewellery, people or text.

images.name: crystals
images.prompt: Object-only clear-to-lilac crystal cluster with glossy flat faces and straight edges. Inside the central translucent crystal, neat repeating rows of tiny glowing dots reveal an abstract crystal pattern, with holographic flashes. No labels or text.

images.name: underground
images.prompt: Object-only storybook earth cutaway: warm layered rock, deep orange heat below, and crystals growing at different sizes inside a rock pocket amid faint hot-water mist. Calm and wondrous; no people, machinery, mine shafts, danger or text.

images.name: geode
images.prompt: Object-only two views of one geode on cream: a whole plain grey-brown rounded rock and an identical cleanly opened rock with a hollow cavity lined in deep-purple crystals and pale chalcedony. No tools, people or text.

images.name: cutting
images.prompt: Object-only left-to-right transformation of one pale aqua stone: rough uncut rock, partly shaped stone with first flat faces, and a finished brilliantly faceted gem, with a polishing cloth. No hands, machines, sparks, hazards or text.

images.name: diamond
images.prompt: Object-only hero colourless brilliant-cut diamond with crisp facets and prismatic flashes beside a small rough octahedral natural diamond, on deep navy velvet. No labels or text.

images.name: ruby-sapphire
images.prompt: Object-only symmetric pair: deep-red ruby and rich-blue sapphire in the same six-sided barrel crystal habit and similar size, plus small pink and yellow cut sapphires. Glossy and translucent on a cream-lilac ground; no text.

images.name: amethyst
images.prompt: Object-only purple amethyst cluster with a tidy foreground row of smaller quartz points in clear, rosy pink, smoky brown and golden yellow, all sharing the six-sided pointed form. Iridescent highlights, dark violet-teal background, no text.

images.name: opal
images.prompt: Object-only milky cabochon opal with spectacular green, blue, magenta and orange play-of-colour, flanked by two smaller opals on a dark soft background. The book's most iridescent page; no text.

images.name: pearl-amber
images.prompt: Object-only split composition: an open oyster shell with a lustrous cream-pink pearl and short pearl strand; beside it warm honey-gold amber containing a tiny leaf, with a pine sprig and sap drop. Sea-glass teal and warm gold; no animals, people or text.

images.name: back-home
images.prompt: Square closing page matching the approved cover: same room, window, table, children, Vanilla, exact outfits and age difference in later golden afternoon. Gems are tidied in the open jewel box; picture-book spines are abstract and the magnifying glass rests nearby. Calm finished-for-now curiosity; no text.
